statements.subject: participant
statements.description: In order to eliminate possible confusions about the addition or subtraction of entire header fields, senders SHOULD replicate all header fields from the request within the signed body.
actions: replicate all header fields from the request within the signed body

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Any message bodies that require integrity protection MUST be attached to the "inner" message.
actions: attach message bodies requiring integrity protection to the inner message

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: If a Date header is present in a message with a signed body, the recipient SHOULD compare the header field value with its own internal clock, if applicable.
actions: compare Date header field value with internal clock

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: If a significant time discrepancy is detected (on the order of an hour or more), the user agent SHOULD alert the user to the anomaly, and note that it is a potential security breach.
actions: note that the anomaly is a potential security breach

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If an integrity violation in a message is detected by its recipient, the message MAY be rejected with a 403 (Forbidden) response if it is a request, or any existing dialog MAY be terminated.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: If an integrity violation in a message is detected by its recipient, the message MAY be rejected with a 403 (Forbidden) response if it is a request, or any existing dialog MAY be terminated.

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: UAs SHOULD notify users of this circumstance and request explicit guidance on how to proceed.
actions: notify user of integrity violation circumstance
request explicit guidance on how to proceed
